STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_05136_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_05136_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_05136 (
    address,
    begintransfer,
    clk,
    read,
    reset_n,
    write,
    writedata,
    LCD_E,
    LCD_RS,
    LCD_RW,
    LCD_data,
    readdata
);

  input  [1:0] address;
  input        begintransfer;
  input        clk;
  input        read;
  input        reset_n;
  input        write;
  input  [7:0] writedata;

  output       LCD_E;
  output       LCD_RS;
  output       LCD_RW;
  inout  [7:0] LCD_data;
  output [7:0] readdata;

  wire         LCD_E;
  wire         LCD_RS;
  wire         LCD_RW;
  wire  [7:0]  readdata;
  wire  [7:0]  LCD_data_internal;

  assign LCD_RW = address[0];
  assign LCD_RS = address[1];
  assign LCD_E = read | write;
  
  // Tri-state buffer logic for LCD_data
  assign LCD_data = (address[0]) ? 8'bz : writedata;
  assign LCD_data_internal = (address[0]) ? LCD_data : 8'bz;

  // Reading data from LCD_data
  assign readdata = LCD_data_internal;

endmodule
